verdict.rationale: Docusaurus ships an official CLI (create-docusaurus scaffolding, docusaurus start/build/deploy, versioning CLI, swizzle) documented at /docs/cli and verified via a real runtime probe that scaffolded a working site with no keys or lock-in. This CLI is a standard dev-workflow tool rather than AI-agent-specific tooling, and there's no independent corroboration of AI-native usage patterns. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-specific CLI features or independent (non-vendor) confirmation of agentic use of the CLI.
